visualCharacteristics.purpose: Stacked bordered download boxes with file type and size, grouped under headings
visualCharacteristics.layout: Titled groups; download boxes stacked at half width from 960px; plain links as an arrow list
notable: Meta line (e.g. PDF, 879 KB) with a file icon
Non-file links in the same group render as arrow links

contentPattern.structure: One cell: headings start groups; list items or paragraphs with one link each; text after the link is the file meta line

usage: Use for a list of downloadable documents, optionally followed by related links.
reuseGuidance: Fits documents with type and size meta; download-list covers the project's existing 10-column list layout.
